svg.title: Purged Epoch K-Fold, five chronological folds on one continuous ERP recording
svg.desc: Each test fold is a contiguous time block. Epochs whose half-open sample windows overlap test epochs are purged from training, not randomly mixed. The labels are alternating classes in a fixed thirty-epoch synthetic example.
svg.text: One run · 30 chronological epochs · event spacing 100 samples · epoch window 500 samples · balanced classes A/B
Colors follow the actual split semantics; no resampling of event order
Why a neighboring epoch is purged (fold 1)
Half-open sample intervals [start, stop): touching at the boundary does not count as overlap
Overlap: train.start < test.stop AND test.start < train.stop. Each run is purged independently; adjacent runs do not share sample indices.
